All started out positive with this company. We ordered a brake control module, which was supposed to come plug and play. My husband installed it but it wouldn't communicate with the vehicle. We returned the first one and they sent a second unit which did not communicate with the vehicle either. We were told that we had to go to the dealer to get it programmed. At this point, we should have insisted on a full refund of $562, but we agreed (in writing) to take only $100 refund. That was almost two months ago. To date, we have not been refunded. Called 3 or 4 times and have been told that their bank is having problems with completing the refunds but that they are working on it and will keep us posted. Interesting how they didn't seem to have any problems taking our payment. At this point, pretty sure it's a line that we are being given and we're never going to see that refund. Such a shame that you can't trust anyone to keep their word.

The body work done on my car was satisfactory, not great,  but the communications and updates were lacking. I was told that I would receive regular updates via text by my advisor, Andrew. After a week of no communications I called to ensure they had my correct contact information. After my call, I received a text update that I called for status. Over the 30 days, I reached out a total of 3 times to request an update. The last update, I was told by Andrew that my car would be ready for pickup the next day, unless I heard otherwise from him. I didn't hear otherwise, and I knew they closed at 6pm, so I showed up at 5pm the next day as promised. Andrew meets me in the lobby and said they can't release the car to me on the day it was promised.  I was furious at this point.  So I get in my rental car that was overdue to be returned and drove home. The minute I get home, a peer of Andrew's calls to say that I can come pick up my car.
